categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Consensus label and modifies signature-cache key generation and input assertions used during block and transaction validation.
categories.rationale: Defensively asserts input preconditions and clarifies serialization in signature-cache key hashing to prevent potential collision hazards. Prompted by the Elements rangeproof-cache collision vulnerability, but addresses latent ambiguity rather than an active bug in Bitcoin Core.
